_comment: Overrides for scripts/appimage-notices.py, which adds the notices and source
pointers for the Ubuntu libraries Tauri's linuxdeploy copies into the AppImage.
Paths are AppDir-relative fnmatch patterns; license_files are relative to this
file. Every file no Ubuntu package owns must match 'own' or 'files', or the step
fails. {placeholders} are read from the AppImage runtime.

own.reason: The app's executable, built from this repository; the code it links is listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt
Desktop entry the Tauri bundler writes from tauri.conf.json
The app's icons from src-tauri/icons, drawn from media-sources/antenna-icon.af
Copy of the largest app icon, made by the Tauri bundler
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk; lists the bundled pixbuf loaders
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (gio-querymodules) when it bundles GIO modules; lists their names only
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk; lists the bundled GTK input methods
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk with glib-compile-schemas from the bundled schema files

files.reason: The Tauri bundler downloads AppRun-x86_64 from the tauri-apps/binary-releases 'apprun-old' release, a mirror of AppImageKit's continuous build; linuxdeploy renames it when it adds the GTK hook
Launcher script linuxdeploy generates to run the hooks in apprun-hooks/ before AppRun.wrapped
Hook script written by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk, which the Tauri bundler downloads from tauri-apps/linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (master)

extra.name: AppImage type2-runtime
extra.license: MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib
sources: Statically links libfuse {libfuse_version} (LGPL-2.1, patched by patches/libfuse in the runtime source): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/tag/fuse-{libfuse_version}
Statically links musl (MIT), zstd {zstd_version} (BSD-3-Clause) and zlib {zlib_version} (Zlib) from the Alpine Linux release named in the runtime source's scripts/chroot/chroot_build.sh
extra.reason: The runtime is the AppImage's ELF header, outside the squashfs, so no package owns it. Texts vendored from upstream (licenses/README.md); the runtime commit pins the exact sources

extra.name: AppImageKit AppRun
extra.reason: AppImageKit's LICENSE at its last commit before the mirrored build

extra.name: linuxdeploy
extra.reason: Only linuxdeploy's generated AppRun script ships; LICENSE.txt from linuxdeploy/linuxdeploy

extra.name: linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk
extra.reason: LICENSE.txt from tauri-apps/linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk at dda522b, the branch the Tauri bundler downloads
